mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 86 degrees. The overnight low will be 69 degrees with no rain predicted. Look for the ISS at 3:31 AM as it travels from the northwest over Verona High School toward the east northeast by Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has installed a new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics in Century School Park, created by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland. The work, carved from a reclaimed ash tree, was donated by Gerri Gurman and features traditional Tai Chi animal movements.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Trivia is happening today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market, line up for pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or try your luck at trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Looking at recent reports, on August 30, officers responded to an incident on North Edge Trail where a suspect intentionally smashed a vehicle window; the suspect is currently being sought by the police.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a treat.
